description:
How does trauma disconnect us from ourselves? This week, I’m joined by the renowned Dr. Gabor Maté @gabormatemd to uncover how our survival patterns from childhood can lead to disconnection from our authentic selves—and how that disconnection often shows up as stress, illness, or emotional pain. We explore the healing power of curiosity and compassion, practical ways to reconnect with our true selves, and the brain’s incredible capacity for change.

This conversation (linked in my bio) offers a powerful invitation to break free from old patterns, reconnect with yourself, and move toward a more aligned way of living. It’s one you won’t want to miss.

#gabormate #drscottlyons #mindbodytherapy #somaticawareness #traumahealing
